verdict.rationale: Flagright is a compliance platform, and self-hosting or on-prem deployment is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a hosted API with vendor-run sandbox servers. Its own docs pitch it as a way to avoid 'investing in infrastructure', and nothing documents a self-hostable core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
